# `Scanner/GhostAside-v0` · The fastest scan that keeps each tube's ghost off its regions

**D · Image quality and artefacts** · artefacts · kind 2, set · isolates D16: Ghosts of periodic motion along the phase-encode axis. [The map](../../docs/tasks.md)

**Status:** CANDIDATE: the gate has not been run (no stored result)

The line-to-line time axis. Periodic change over the phase-encode lines shows as copies of the changing material along the phase-encode axis, at a distance set by its rate, the repetition time and the averages. The rate is hidden: it is read from the ghost distance of a scan, and it decides how long the repetition time must be before the ghosts have left the regions.

Kind of task: **undetermined** (Measurement task or decision task (does a fixed list of scans pass within 25 points of the reference?): not determined, the gate result is not stored yet.).

## World

- On the table: QA phantom (a disc of gel) with three placed tubes, 1.5 T; a declared motion model (limits.md, section 7)
- Sequences that matter here: se, spgr
- Formulas the agent is given: ghost distance = phase field of view x dist(rate x TR x averages) along the phase-encode axis, on both sides of the pulsating material; scan time = overhead + TR x (1 + lines)

|  | any stored image, and the numbers along any line through it |

## Deliverable and reward

- Deliverable: `submit` with `{'scans': {'<tube id>': {'pe_dir': 'y | x', 'tr_ms': '<milliseconds>'}}}`
- Reward range [0.0, 1.0]; paid only at submit; 0 on every other step
- Gates: the scanner log replays and is within budget; at least one accepted scan; the console accepts every delivered scan and its repetition time lies in the window
- Error: `largest over the regions of: |mean of (scan - scan at rest)| / |mean of the scan at rest| (noise-free)`
- Score: `none: the reward is 1 for a pass and 0 otherwise`
- Passing: all gates and, for every tube: error <= 2 % in both of its regions and scan time <= 1.1 x the fastest scan that keeps them clear

## Gate: the control policies on fresh instances

**Gate not stored on this engine** (`mrgym-engine-0.2.0`). `mrgym gate Scanner/GhostAside-v0 --n 300 --write` measures and stores it.

| Policy | Must | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `reference` | pass | the target scan at the shortest TR with either axis; ghost distance -> rate; per axis the first TR that puts the ghost clear of the region; the faster axis, plus 5 % |
| `prior` | fail | no scan; the shortest repetition time, pe_dir y |
| `shortest_tr` | fail | one token scan, then the shortest repetition time, pe_dir y |
| `fixed_recipe` | fail | one token scan, then a constant repetition time and axis, or an assumed rate or ghost position in the law with the told distances, tuned on other worlds |
| `sweep` | fail | the target scan at two repetition times with pe_dir y; per tube the one at which its two regions look more alike |
| `wrong_units` | fail | the reference's repetition time in seconds |
| `fixed_axis` | ablation | the reference with pe_dir y only |
| `assume_ghost` | ablation | the reference without asking whether a ghost lies on the tube's regions at all |
| `open_loop` | reported | the reference: a fixed scan list and a fixed estimator |

## What the agent reads at reset (level 2, seed 0)

~~~text
# The fastest scan that keeps each tube's ghost off its regions
A disc of gel holds three thin tubes of fluid whose signal can pulsate, each at a rate of its own. In an image a
pulsating tube leaves displaced copies of itself (ghosts) along the phase-encode axis; how far they lie from the tube
depends on the timing of the scan.
Each tube has two marked regions: A in its column (same x) and B in its row (same y).
For each tube the examination needs a spin-echo scan of its own, as fast as possible, in which both regions of that
tube are free of its ghost:
    sequence se, te_ms 15, fov_mm 240, matrix 128, bandwidth_hz_per_px 300, 1 average, slice 5 mm;
    you choose pe_dir and tr_ms, with tr_ms from 300 to 1000.
Every tube pulsates, at a few tenths of a hertz. At tr_ms 300 a ghost of every tube lies on one of its regions,
whichever phase-encode axis is chosen.
Tubes (radius 5 mm) and regions (circles of radius 12 mm); positions in mm from the isocentre:
  T1: tube at y -54.5, x 52.4; region T1A at y -34, x 52.4; region T1B at y -54.5, x 24.9
  T2: tube at y 0.8, x 1.9; region T2A at y 22.7, x 1.9; region T2B at y 0.8, x -26.8
  T3: tube at y 52.4, x -54.3; region T3A at y 24.6, x -54.3; region T3B at y 52.4, x -32.6
Deliver the two settings of every tube's scan with `submit`. The target scans are not run in this episode: the scanner
evaluates the settings you deliver, without noise.
Your own scans may use any sequence and any parameters the console accepts; only the deliverable is evaluated, on the scan the task names.
That scan is not charged to the scan-time budget and not limited by it.
The rates are not known in advance.

Passing, for every tube, in the scan delivered for it, compared with the same scan of the object at rest:
  1. in each of the tube's two regions the mean ghost signal over the area of the region is at most 2 % of its mean signal;
  2. the scan time is at most 10 % above that of the fastest scan that satisfies rule 1 (either pe_dir, any tr_ms from 300 to 1000).
The scanner's log must show that you measured. A value in another unit is wrong.

Limits. Scan time: 130 s (only `scan` spends it). Tool calls: 64 (every call counts once unless rejected). Rejected calls: 8 (a call refused for how it is written: unknown name, wrong type; costs nothing else), of them at most 3 refused `submit` calls. The episode ends at `submit` or at a limit; without `submit` the score is 0.
[scan time left 130.00 of 130 s · calls 0/64 · rejected 0/8]
~~~

## Determinism and versions

same (seed, level, tool calls) -> same observations, log hash chain and reward; a repeated scan draws new noise; the verifier's scans are noise-free.

Rewards are comparable only within one environment version (the `-vN` suffix) and one scanner engine (`mrgym --version`).
